id: P8d joint ocean-land multistart development campaign
hypothesis: Sea-only corrections expose land responses tuned around wrong seas. Joint shared responses may improve both; different starts test dependence on the fitted basin.

budget.continuation: All starts receive identical budget; no dropping weak first generations or changing knobs after results.

objective: Existing policy_v3 S49 and aggregate temperature/rain safeguards. No regional/group veto. All 49 development regions; h/f/g remain spent.
forcing: joint.earth_profile holds Earth orbital/radiative forcing/geography and modeled SST/winds; only six continuous shared response parameters vary. Numerical criteria unchanged.
bounds_basis: Existing model response ranges and prior maritime-refit thermal timescale/amplitude bounds. Offsets/current anomalies are phenomenological parameters, not a resolved ocean heat budget.
followup: Report all trajectories and failures. Compare marine diagnostics on same six known coasts for all three best profiles. Candidates passing S49<=.995 and T/P changes<=1% advance to fresh paired dev/finer28 checks and spent-h stress. No new independent pool or adoption in this campaign.
limits: Two CMA generations per start are an early bounded refit, not convergence or global-minimum proof. r44/v2.2 and its corrections remain published unless independently qualified replacement.
reference_context: All49 fresh paired references. 48 reproduce historical r44 errors; Tripolitania uses documented Nov2 recovered182-cell footprint instead of archived195. Direct WorldClim rebuild verified. No optimizer candidate run before this declaration.
